description: This file defines an Angular component named NoteEditorComponent, responsible for editing notes. It includes properties and methods for handling note content, tags, and actions like save, delete, and toggle pinned status.

classes.name: NoteEditorComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing notes, capable of modifying note content, tags, and handling save/delete actions.

methods.name: onTitleChange
methods.description: Triggers save emit when the note title changes.

methods.name: onContentChange
methods.description: Triggers save emit when the note content changes.

methods.name: togglePinned
methods.description: Toggles the pinned status of the note and emits save.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds new tags to the note, ensuring uniqueness, then emits save.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a specified tag from the note and emits save.

methods.name: emitSave
methods.description: Emits the current state of the note for saving.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Emits a delete event with the note's ID.
